# Link Fest

> Link Fest is an IndexMe.lol page of real outbound links. Put a visible follow link to https://indexme.lol/ on your site, with IndexMe in the anchor text. The board links back to pages that already do that, and to the page that wrote the idea.

The check at /api/check fetches a public HTML page and looks for an `<a href>` whose host is indexme.lol. A passing link is a follow link with IndexMe in the anchor, the image alt, or the aria-label. nofollow is reported on its own. Private hosts, link-local addresses, credentialed URLs, and ports other than 80 and 443 are refused.

## Links

- [IndexMe.lol](https://indexme.lol/): IndexNow, sitemap and robots checks, search console steps. Pro $19.99. Studio $29.99. One time.
- [Free desk](https://indexme.lol/desk/): The check, with no signup.
- [Pricing](https://indexme.lol/#pricing): Starter is free. Pro and Studio are one-time.
- [AgentHive Inc](https://agenthiveinc.com/): Palm Coast shop that publishes IndexMe.
- [LaunchAF listing](https://launchaf.com/products/product-106): Their write-up of the desk. Link Fest links back.
